clips.title: The story
paras: In Darkshore, foul water gathers at the base of the Cliffspring River waterfall. Drawn for Thundris Windweaver in Auberdine, the vial shows that corruption is moving toward the coast.

The Cliffspring River runs from Darkshore's eastern heights, past ancient stone bridges, and into the sea at Mist's Edge. Its clear waters have turned foul and visibly corrupted. Thundris Windweaver, a night elf in Auberdine, fears the tainted flow will reach the settlement's shore and water supply. He sent travelers to draw water from the pool beneath the river's lower waterfall. The sample confirms that unnatural rot is moving downstream toward the coast.
